snippet.description:
How should you revise effectively for UPSC Mains? Simply reading and revising topics is not enough. Your revision must be combined with regular answer writing to improve your ability to recall, structure and present information in the examination.

Enroll in MMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/H3J3W

In this video, we discuss a practical approach to UPSC Mains revision:

- Study a topic or revise it through reverse revision.
- Go through Previous Year Questions (PYQs) related to the topic.
- Analyse the demand of the questions and brainstorm possible points.
- Practise writing answers based on the topic.
- Aim to write at least 3 answers daily, or practise on alternate days if a daily schedule is not possible.

Remember, revision without answer writing is incomplete. The real test of your preparation is how effectively you can reproduce what you have studied in the examination.
